name: copilot-memory-store
description: Local JSON memory store with CLI + MCP server for GitHub Copilot / MCP clients.

scripts.pkg:cli:gcc: set PATH=E:\nasm;%PATH% && set CC=E:\V-pan-FIX\D-pan\mingw64\bin\gcc.exe && set CXX=E:\V-pan-FIX\D-pan\mingw64\bin\g++.exe && pkg dist/cli.js --build --targets node16-win-x64 --output bin/copilot-memory-store.exe
scripts.pkg:mcp:gcc: set PATH=E:\nasm;%PATH% && set CC=E:\V-pan-FIX\D-pan\mingw64\bin\gcc.exe && set CXX=E:\V-pan-FIX\D-pan\mingw64\bin\g++.exe && pkg dist/mcp-server.js --build --targets node16-win-x64 --output bin/copilot-memory-mcp.exe
scripts.pkg:trae:gcc: set PATH=E:\nasm;%PATH% && set CC=E:\V-pan-FIX\D-pan\mingw64\bin\gcc.exe && set CXX=E:\V-pan-FIX\D-pan\mingw64\bin\g++.exe && pkg dist/trae-mcp-server.js --build --targets node16-win-x64 --output bin/copilot-memory-trae.exe
scripts.pkg:all:gcc: npm run build && npm run pkg:cli:gcc && npm run pkg:mcp:gcc && npm run pkg:trae:gcc
scripts.create:bat: node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>{fs.mkdirSync('bin',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('bin/copilot-memory-store.bat','@echo off\nnode %~dp0/../dist/cli.js %*');fs.writeFileSync('bin/copilot-memory-mcp.bat','@echo off\nnode %~dp0/../dist/mcp-server.js %*');console.log('Created batch files in bin/ directory');})"
scripts.create:bat:trae: node -e "import('fs').then(fs=>{fs.mkdirSync('bin',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('bin/copilot-memory-trae.bat','@echo off\nnode %~dp0/../dist/trae-mcp-server.js %*');console.log('Created trae batch file in bin/ directory');})"
